name: Men Pleasers
overview: Scripture warns against placing trust in human approval rather than in God, as trusting in man leads the heart away from the LORD and is cursed (Jeremiah 17:5). Jesus teaches that seeking to justify ourselves before men is futile because what is highly esteemed by people can be an abomination to God (Luke 16:15). Believers are called to obey God above men (Acts 5:29) and to avoid conforming to worldly standards, instead renewing their minds to discern God's perfect will (Romans 12:2). The apostle Paul emphasizes that pleasing men is incompatible with serving Christ (Galatians 1:10), though believers are still instructed to serve earthly authorities with sincerity as if serving Christ (Ephesians 6:5). Together, these verses highlight the necessity of prioritizing God's approval over human approval in all aspects of life.
